title: PRODUCTION PLANNING AND CONTROL
description: Forecasting techniques, inventory analysis, master production scheduling, material and capacity requirements, planning and scheduling methods.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: IE 255 or ST 314.
A minimum grade of C is required in IE 255 and ST 314.

Enrollment limited to students in the College of Engineering college.
books_html: No-cost: Course utilizes open educational resources, materials available through the library, or does not require any purchased materials.
meeting_html: TR 10am-11:50am in BAT 150 - Batcheller Hall 150 (GP) (9/23 to 12/4)
